ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  ADF Foods Limited reported strong year-over-year performance for Q1 FY27, with consolidated revenue growing 25.9% to Rs. 16,728.89 lakhs and profit after tax (attributable to owners) increasing 13.4% to Rs. 1,728.52 lakhs compared to the previous year. However, the company experienced a notable sequential decline from the prior quarter (Q4 FY26), with consolidated revenue dropping 15.0% and profit falling 36.7%. Auditors noted reliance on unreviewed financial information for three subsidiaries which reported a combined net loss of Rs. (115.82) lakhs, but deemed it not material to the Group and did not modify their conclusion.
